patterns: PYQs are direct single-fact attributions: who gave surplus value / scientific socialism / co-wrote Communist Manifesto (Marx, Engels).
Thinker-concept and book-author matching is the recurring shape; Marx is the most-asked Western founder.
UPPSC-style assertion items on national integration (NIC 1961, dimensions) appear; dates of bodies are the trap.
Current-affairs tie-ins (International Mother Language Day - February) show up under this topic.
App MCQs lean heavily on long match/statement items derived from notes (Weber action types, Simmel dyads, social stability lists) - deeper and wordier than the PYQs.
